result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best overall password manager.

It's a strong choice because it balances security, ease of use, centralized administration, and secure sharing without requiring a dedicated IT team.

However, the best option depends on your team size, budget, and whether you need to manage employee access to shared accounts.

## My top 4 picks

![1Password: Password Manager | Apps | Godly](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9Onad3ZmM68M7l5dTIbPMn43a-YB12X_e9tFS-w_jdjYbB1mwCcSBgDwHjfxiov3sFv56iK_BYB0DBDy1ElBpKTj_x8BM6wjwBy4mijsixFzsgcbh4l6IAVcN_W3xEYaPv3HJbWtjoYtl68hPIh1Q4uMTSZR5QKnTsp4CKPumigoRyeUfSzM6z8piMAIIqVa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience
- Shared vaults with granular permissions
- Strong admin controls and reporting
- Good employee onboarding/offboarding

Best for teams that value simplicity and security.

[Website and plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

- Open-source
- Shared collections
- Audit/event logs
- Good administration features

Best if you want strong security at a lower price.

[Website and plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Security**

- Strong administrative controls
- Shared team folders
- Delegated administration
- Good compliance-oriented features

Best for businesses with more formal security requirements.

[Website and plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused
- Secure sharing
- Simple interface
- Good fit for teams already using Proton services

Best for privacy-conscious organizations.

[Website and plans](https://proton.me/business/pass)

## Approximate pricing comparison

Prices below are advertised starting prices in USD, generally with annual billing. Confirm current regional pricing before purchasing.

| Product | Starting price/user/month |
|--------|--------|
| Keeper Business Starter | \$2 |
| Bitwarden Teams | \$4 |
| 1Password Business | \$8.99 |
| Proton Pass | Depends on plan |


Sources: [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd prioritize

For a small business, make sure your password manager supports\:

1. Shared vaults for departments or projects.
2. Individual user accounts (never share one master login).
3. Immediate access revocation when employees leave.
4. MFA enforcement.
5. Audit logs and access controls.
6. Secure sharing of API keys, Wi-Fi credentials and other secrets.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the right plan rather than have you pay for unnecessary enterprise features.

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

---
